# Tooltips: a target in a second window shows its tooltip in that window

## Context

Split from #21882's AC-3; PR #22019 delivers the rest of that leaf (the keyboard path and the sprint-board example in `examples/tooltip`). The review of #22019 asked for the second-window case to have an owner before #21882 closes.

## The Problem

#21882 asks for "a target in a second window whose tooltip appears in that window". A second window needs the example to run on SharedWorkers with a child app opened through `Neo.Main.windowOpen`, and the landing cover of a SharedWorker example needs #22010 (PR #22014, the SharedWorker landing capture), which is still open.

## The Architectural Reality

- One shared tooltip per browser window (`Neo.tooltip.Base.createSingleton(app, windowId)`, from #21268): no engine gap is known.
- `examples/stateProvider/multiWindow` is the pattern: `useSharedWorkers: true`, and `MainContainerController#onOpenSecondWindowButtonClick` opens `../multiWindow2/index.html`.

## The Fix

`examples/tooltip` runs on SharedWorkers, and a toolbar button opens a companion window whose own board carries hinted targets; their tooltips appear in that window. The cover pair is re-captured once #22010 is closed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A second window opened from the board shows its own targets' tooltips in that window, by pointer and by keyboard.
- [ ] No console error in either window, in every theme the example offers.
- [ ] The landing cover still captures in both schemes.

## Out of Scope

The tooltip engine and the rest of the example (#21882, PR #22019).
